scope: Record the user's acceptance of the practical R08 scope, retaining the user's scientific-decision correction and unperformed-check limits. Add only snapshot, acceptance and audit records; no additional review bureaucracy, participant processing, scientific change or disclosure/release clearance.
negative_control_method: In-memory fixtures only: sixteen false authority/certification flags individually set true; formal D1_rights approval introduced; text fixtures erased the user's scientific-decision clause, reinstated the blanket joint-review requirement or invented disclosure clearance. Corresponding checks rejected all 20 mutants. No fixture written to any source or packet.
snapshot_provenance: Same-agent comparison with the immediately preceding practical R08 account. Frozen substantive text includes the author's correction, all scope choices, unperformed checks and prior-turn review-status/no-change statements under a separate acceptance/provenance preamble. Chat memory citation excluded. No platform-authenticated export or message ID claimed. Hashes identify saved artifacts only.
review_method: Same-agent content and authority-boundary review, 38 positive checks and 20 negative controls, with before/after preservation compared before final audit creation. Final saved-file checks run afterward; audit not self-hashed. This verifies the documentary update, not safety of the underlying data, tables, figures, code or publication package.

proposed_commit.title: docs: record acceptance of practical R08 disclosure-review scope
description: Preserve the practical R08 account and record the author's exact documentary acceptance dated 25 October 2026.

Keep methodological, results and interpretation decisions with the user. Do not adopt the earlier blanket joint-author-review requirement or introduce new forms, committees or appointments; preserve existing obligations without assuming approvals.
Limit the proposed public package to the final paper and selected appendices; retain respondent-level inputs/auxiliary outputs under restricted custody.
Retain specific review for individual-level figures and small/rare tables, identifier exclusion from public materials, restricted originals/exclusion rules and whole-package version scope.
Distinguish accepted scope from checks not performed. Do not certify disclosure safety, implement changes, resolve R07 or authorize release.
Validate 38 content/status checks and 20 negative controls; verify all pre-existing tracked files and the complete prior private audit tree.
No participant inspection, contacts, fitting, scientific changes, source edits, transformations, commit, push, synchronization, submission or release.

completion_boundary: Practical R08 scope accepted and recorded for documentary purposes only. Actual disclosure checks, final exhibit inventory and any release decision remain unperformed or unresolved. R09 (access, reuse licence and replication-package scope within the narrowed route) is next, not automatically initiated.

preservation.method: SHA-256 over UTF-8 concatenation of case-sensitive PowerShell-sorted absolute_full_path<TAB>length<TAB>uppercase_file_SHA256<LF> records; hidden files included. Private-file bytes were opaque preservation objects only; no participant values parsed, interpreted or displayed.
preservation.scope_limit: All 1,258 pre-existing tracked files and all 23,281 prior audit-local files were rehashed. No pre-existing untracked files were present. External originals, participants, current output/data contents, code identifiers, package composition and disclosure risk were not inspected. New R08 artifacts are excluded from old-file preservation groups.
